name: Liquefy
body:
You can ooze out of bonds and grapples.

Prerequisite: Evade Grasp, Squole.

Benefit: Once per day as a swift action, you can automatically escape a grapple or free yourself from all bonds or shackles.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
